exam.title: IELTS Writing Sample Test
exam.description: Sample Writing test with Task 1 and Task 2 prompts.

groups.instruction: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

questions.prompt: The table below shows the percentage of students choosing different university subjects in three years. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

groups.instruction: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

questions.topic: Some people believe that technology has made communication between people less personal. Others think it has helped people communicate more effectively. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
